scope: Zero search FE, zero decoder calls. Structural availability only; final paid ND archives selected in advance, not all paid observations.
question: Does matching each factory's own job set expose distinct complete local encodings unavailable under matching the entire FA?
control: Both libraries use identical paid parent archives and unrestricted retained records; only whole-FA versus local-job-set matching differs. This is not a replay of the current cap8 protected-family pool and not a measured improvement over its actual chooser.
gate: At least20% of paid receivers on each instance have a distinct local encoding from another whole FA absent among same-whole-FA sources. A pass authorizes offline objective/decode diagnostics only, never a selector or whole-budget run.
limits: No role producer metadata, objective gain, fatigue specificity, novelty, timing advantage or whole-run benefit can be inferred from counts.
